title: Minutes from a transcript
summary: Write minutes: summary, decisions and action items.

inputs.transcript:
Ana: Shall we move the launch to July?
Ben: Yes, July works.
Ana: Agreed, July then. Ben, can you update the plan by Friday?
Ben: Will do.
Cara: We might also want a new logo.

Ana: Should we change suppliers?
Ben: Not sure.
Ana: Let's think about it.

sections.use: Turn a meeting transcript into minutes: a summary, the decisions agreed and the action items.
sections.exclusions: Decisions only where the transcript shows agreement; suggestions are not listed.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 6,144 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Transcript up to 40,000 characters; up to 30 decisions and 50 action items.
sections.missing_data: Empty lists when there are no decisions or actions. Unidentified or anonymously labelled owners are null; unstated deadlines are null.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

outputs.summary: A short summary of the meeting.
outputs.action_items: Action items in source order: task, identified owner (or null) and stated deadline (or null).
